title: Which Points Reduction the Snowsports School Takes Off a Booking
content:
Which of the two reductions the Snowsports School actually takes off a booking is settled before either is applied, and it turns on whether the household is staying with the collective and on how far ahead the booking was recorded.

**Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state and the booking was recorded fourteen or more days ahead of its first session**, the advance points and the stay points are combined into one total in percentage points and the block price is reduced once by that total.

**Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state and the booking was recorded fewer than fourteen days ahead of its first session**, the stay points alone are taken and the advance points are not taken at all.

**Where the household holds no Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state**, the advance points alone are taken.

## The three cases side by side

| Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state | Booking recorded ahead of its first session | What is taken off the block price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 14 calendar days or more | the advance points and the stay points as one combined total, acting once |
| yes | fewer than 14 calendar days | the stay points alone |
| no | 14 calendar days or more | the advance points alone |
| no | fewer than 14 calendar days | the advance points alone |

The two are never taken one after the other on what the first left: where both are taken, they are added together first and the block price is reduced once by the sum.

## An illustration on a hypothetical block price

Take a block price of 1000.00 USD, advance points of 8 and stay points of 14.

- A household with a confirmed Resort Lodging reservation whose booking was recorded 20 days ahead has 22 points taken off in one act, leaving 780.00 USD.
- A household with a confirmed Resort Lodging reservation whose booking was recorded 5 days ahead has the 14 stay points taken off alone, leaving 860.00 USD, the advance points not being taken at all.
- A household with no confirmed Resort Lodging reservation has the 8 advance points taken off alone, leaving 920.00 USD.
